verdict.rationale: Temporal ships an official CLI (temporal) available for macOS, Linux, Windows, and Docker, bundling a local dev server and Web UI, confirmed by docs and a runtime probe showing it actually runs and reports version info. It's not AI-specific tooling but is a genuine first-party CLI for building/running Temporal apps, which AI-native users would use alongside Temporal's documented AI/agent workflows. Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-specific CLI subcommands (e.g., agent scaffolding, MCP integration commands) or independent hands-on review of the CLI beyond the single version-check probe.
